name: composition-protocol-agent-skills
description: Agent capabilities for Composition Protocol: Daml template development, Canton Ledger API v2 integration, Express routing, and atomicity/privacy test gates.

skills.name: Build & Refine Daml Templates
skills.description: Author, compile, and validate Daml 3.x smart contracts conforming to CIP-0056 and atomic multi-asset composition patterns.
capabilities: Create and modify ComposableAsset interface implementations
Maintain CompositionProposal, AcceptanceTracker, and CompositionAgreement lifecycle contracts
Implement SettlementReceipt with strict observer privacy scoping
Build M-of-N GovernedSettlement templates for BitSafe decentralization
Execute 'daml build' and compile DAR artifacts
constraints: Strictly adhere to Daml 3.x syntax and --target=2.1 compiler target
All asset transfers within an agreement must run in a single atomic transaction choice
Never disclose raw token contract IDs or payloads to observer/regulator parties

skills.name: Integrate Canton Ledger API v2 Bridge
skills.description: Interface Node.js/TypeScript backend with Canton JSON Ledger API v2 (:7575) or fallback to the in-memory demoStore.
capabilities: Construct Ledger API v2 submit-and-wait commands for contract creation and choice exercise
Query Active Contract Sets (ACS) filtered by party offset and template ID
Encode data types correctly: Decimal as JSON string, Date as YYYY-MM-DD, Optional as value|null
Handle OIDC token authentication against Keycloak endpoints
Maintain synchronization between in-memory demo store and live ledger client
constraints: Port defaults to 7575 for local Canton JSON API and 4000 for Express backend
Ensure fallback to demoStore when LEDGER_API_URL is unset
Validate party identifiers and token metadata prior to dispatching ledger commands

skills.name: Setup & Extend Express Routes
skills.description: Implement RESTful and demo orchestration endpoints in Express for frontend consumption.
capabilities: Manage /compositions lifecycle endpoints: propose, accept, settle, and demo load generation
Manage /governance endpoints: open, approve, and execute M-of-N deals
Serve /audit and /audit/money-shot endpoints for side-by-side privacy verification
Manage /assets endpoints for minting and token inventory queries
Support CORS and JSON payloads with comprehensive error status mapping (400, 404, 409)
constraints: Maintain atomic revert error responses (HTTP 409) with atomic: true flag
Provide real-time metrics tracking on settlements, reverts, and leg counts
Ensure demo routes support forceFail and requireGovernance flags

skills.name: Run Atomicity, Privacy & Governance Tests
skills.description: Execute automated acceptance tests verifying all core protocol invariants.
capabilities: Run backend test suite using tsx --test src/demoStore.test.ts
Verify testAtomicSwap: all-or-nothing multi-leg settlement
Verify testAtomicRevert: zero half-settled state when an individual leg fails
Verify testAuditorCannotSeeLegs: regulator ACS has visibleTokens: [] and valid SettlementReceipt
Verify R-GOV-1 & R-GOV-2: M-of-N below-threshold rejection and at-threshold execution
Execute Daml Script tests via daml test when Daml SDK 3.3.x is available
constraints: All 5 primary acceptance tests must pass before approving code merges
Zero regressions in privacy guarantees or atomicity behavior allowed
